_about: Public-domain Crawford Howell Toy (1836-1919), Baptist-trained Hebraist and Hancock professor at Harvard, for the Word Hoard: The History of the Religion of Israel, Quotations in the New Testament, Judaism and Christianity, A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on Proverbs (International Critical Commentary), and his Ezekiel in the Polychrome Bible (English translation and Hebrew critical edition). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 118 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

toy-religion-israel: The history of the religion of Israel : an Old Testament primer (Boston : Unitarian Sunday-School Society, 1884)
toy-quotations: Quotations in the New Testament (New York, Scribner, 1884)
toy-judaism-christianity: Judaism and Christianity; a sketch of the progress of thought from Old Testament to New Testament (Boston, Little, Brown, 1890)
toy-proverbs: A critical and exegetical commentary on the book of Proverbs (New York, C. Scribner's sons, 1899)
toy-ezekiel-english: The Book of the Prophet Ezekiel: A New English Translation, with Explanatory Notes and Pictorial (Dodd, 1899)
toy-ezekiel-hebrew: The book of the prophet Ezekiel: Critical Edition of the Hebrew Text with Notes (John Hopkins Press, 1899)
